title: New Business Idea
description: A new Data, Analytics or AI capability intended to solve a business problem or create measurable value.

title: Existing Prototype
description: A business-built PoC, automation, spreadsheet or local solution that may need to become scalable and supported.

title: Bring New Data
description: A new source, ingestion requirement, API, table or data access need that should become consumable.

title: Improve Existing Product
description: A change to an existing supported product, dashboard, data product, model or analytical capability.

title: Operational Support
description: A live production issue that should be handled through the Service Manager and operational support process.
